events.title: Arab armies defeat the Byzantines at the Yarmouk
events.description: After six days of fighting, the Muslim Arab army under Khalid ibn al-Walid destroyed the Byzantine forces near the River Yarmouk. Byzantium lost Syria and Palestine for good.
events.html: After six days of fighting, the Muslim Arab army under Khalid ibn al-Walid destroyed the Byzantine forces near the River Yarmouk. Byzantium lost Syria and Palestine for good.

events.title: Richard I has 2,700 Muslim prisoners executed at Ayyadieh
events.description: When negotiations with Saladin over ransom and the True Cross stalled, Richard the Lionheart had the captured garrison of Acre killed outside the city. The massacre embittered the war.
events.html: When negotiations with Saladin over ransom and the True Cross stalled, Richard the Lionheart had the captured garrison of Acre killed outside the city. The massacre embittered the war.

events.title: Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture has its premiere in Moscow
events.description: Tchaikovsky's overture marking Russia's defeat of Napoleon was first performed in a tent near the unfinished Cathedral of Christ the Saviour. Its cannon and bells made it a perennial favourite.
events.html: Tchaikovsky's overture marking Russia's defeat of Napoleon was first performed in a tent near the unfinished Cathedral of Christ the Saviour. Its cannon and bells made it a perennial favourite.

events.title: Leon Trotsky is struck with an ice axe in Mexico City
events.description: Soviet agent Ramón Mercader attacked Leon Trotsky in his study in Coyoacán; Trotsky died the next day. Stalin had pursued his exiled rival for over a decade.
events.html: Soviet agent Ramón Mercader attacked Leon Trotsky in his study in Coyoacán; Trotsky died the next day. Stalin had pursued his exiled rival for over a decade.

events.title: Warsaw Pact armies invade Czechoslovakia
events.description: Hundreds of thousands of Soviet-led troops crossed into Czechoslovakia overnight to end Alexander Dubček's Prague Spring reforms. Moscow soon claimed the right to intervene in any socialist state.

events.title: US strikes al-Qaeda targets in Afghanistan and Sudan
events.description: In retaliation for the embassy bombings in East Africa, US cruise missiles hit camps in Afghanistan and the al-Shifa pharmaceutical factory in Khartoum, whose link to weapons was disputed.
